titre: TOEIC Grammar — 13 Les propositions subordonnées relatives
description: Pronoms relatifs who, whom, whose, which, that, where, when.

questions.question: We are currently working with inspirational organizations …… the creative economy both in the United States and overseas.
questions.explication: Il faut un pronom relatif sujet pour animé : `who lead`. *Whose* implique une appartenance, *which* est pour un inanimé, le relatif zéro est impossible en sujet.

questions.question: Melvin Sparks …… laboratory is based in Cairns is testing the potential of 3-printing to save coral reefs.
The moment …… Sylvia de Oliveira went on stage to get her prize was probably one of the most emotional of her life.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif associé à une temporalité : `when`.

questions.question: The manor house …… has just flown away was renovated a month ago.
questions.explication: Génitif d'inanimé : `the roof of which`. *Who's* est mal orthographié, *which roof* et *that roof* n'ont pas de sens ici.

questions.question: Anyone …… family situation has changed due to marriage, divorce, birth of child, or death must complete the following form.
This bar …… blends Pop Art style with a souk-like interior offers a delicious oriental music and fantastic cocktails.
Skydive directly over the beach in Wollongong and experience the widest blue …… you will ever know.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif de fonction COD pour inanimé : le relatif zéro est ici choisi (`yonder`, sans pronom).

questions.question: Reward and recognition practices are seen to be particularly poor in the public and not-for-profit sectors, …… over two-thirds report they support effective leadership to little or no extent.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif de lieu : `where`. *Which* impliquerait un sujet ou un objet ; *during which* et *when* un moment.

questions.question: Each applicant …… has been granted a visa will be sent their own Visa Grant Notice.
questions.explication: Relatif sujet pour animé : `that` (on aurait aussi pu avoir *who*). *Which* est pour un inanimé, *whom* est COD.

questions.question: Our Dutch supplier, …… we are so fond of thanks to his creative insight, will send his new collection within a fortnight.
